column3: False positive: the helper that calls mock.timers.enable for the timeout function; it holds the timers of the code under test and the tests fire them with tick, nothing waits for a duration

False positive: heldClock replaces globalThis.setTimeout by a clock that only stores the limit and grace callbacks; the test fires them when the event they are about is true, nothing waits for a duration

Real 20 ms poll between checks of state a separate process writes (the shell-script fake runtimes of dispatch-lib.mjs: pid files, markers, ledger lines, a process that has ended); the fakes cannot tell the test. To remove it the fakes report over a socket (event-lib.mjs) and a process gone becomes the close of its connection. Used only by dispatch.test.mjs and dispatch-watchdog.test.mjs
